changes: Palace-indexed building ownership and shared resident/needs calculations within mutation-aware planning scopes.
Courier route dependencies track actual navigation-region changes; larger bounded outbound cache; 120-game-second expiry.
Lazy bounded reverse destination searches shared by returning couriers, with A* fallback.
Reused movement occupancy/search/position/separation storage, deferred defensive masks, unchanged-geometry fast path, optional movement timings.

simulation.methodology: Identical saved-state clones, alternating baseline/current order, warmup excluded. Fixed timestep, WASM enabled. Simulation only; excludes rendering. Route selection can differ, so world totals are recorded instead of claiming exact trajectory parity.

browser.methodology: Four serial 25-second headless Chrome replays, order baseline/current/current/baseline. Identical initial world and 1440×900 DPR 1 viewport. Both frozen copies use identical baseline main.ts, style.css, renderer.ts and UI modules, verified by hashes. Baseline includes the prior 1 Hz city-label cache. CPU sampling and detailed movement timing disabled. All earlier captures without the clean- prefix are excluded because concurrent HUD changes differed between snapshots.

profile.methodology: Separate 20-second optimized browser replay with the identical baseline UI, CDP CPU sampling and opt-in movement timings. Instrumentation overhead makes its FPS unsuitable for the performance comparison. Inclusive groups overlap and cannot be summed.

fullSuite.note: One assertion expected a second native A* search for a return trip. Updated to validate legal outbound/return paths and reverse search activity. The broad run also discovered 8 duplicate scratch-fixture tests.

limitations: Local measurements on one large settlement; timings vary by run and are not a universal speedup guarantee.
Equal-cost reverse routes and longer cache reuse can change trajectories; no exact whole-game state parity is claimed.
Still-valid routes can miss distant new shortcuts for up to 120 game seconds. Access-changing edits remain live.
Worst browser frame still reached 249.8 ms in optimized runs; stable 60 FPS is not achieved.
Paths remain arrays; spatial frame boundaries still compare scalar geometry to detect direct editor/test mutations. No speculative revision-only invalidation was introduced.

reproduction.browser: Serve frozen baseline/current snapshots separately, then run scripts/profile-live-state.mjs with --state=scratch/2026-10-31-courier-optimization/live-final.json --seconds=25 in alternating order.
reproduction.cpu: Add --cpu --movement to a separate profile-live-state.mjs run; summarize with scripts/summarize-cpu-profile.mjs.
